extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 5bd9410017948cc3c76af87d383c8ce6924b88b4d810382cf34c0957fc85bbcd; the supplied identity is LCSC C7420325, MPN B0540W, manufacturer hongjiacheng.

The datasheet identity is B0520W THRU B0540W SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER, Rev:1.0, three pages. The exact B0540W column and all three pages were examined; the visible manufacturer is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.

Figures 1 through 3 were digitized directly from the supplied vector plots without synthesized or interpolated points. Figures 1 and 2 are grouped B0520W through B0540W typical characteristics; reverse current is represented as the positive magnitude shown on the mA logarithmic axis. Figure 3 is typical junction capacitance at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz.

All extracted electrical quantities use SI units: mV to V, mA to A, and pF to F. Maximum and typical semantics are preserved in source_kind. The B0540W electrical table gives maximum VF = 0.51 V at IF = 0.5 A and 0.62 V at IF = 1.0 A; maximum IR = 0.01 mA at VR = 20 V and 0.02 mA at VR = 40 V; and CT = 170 pF at VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz.

Absolute maximum ratings for B0540W include VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 0.5 A, IFSM = 5.5 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, PD = 500 mW, Tj = -55 to +125 degC, storage temperature = -55 to +150 degC, and RthetaJA = 200 degC/W. These ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data or fitted curve points.

The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings, and the power-derating plot in Fig. 4, are not substituted for breakdown or diode electrical curve data.
